facts.fact: The Sierra Leone Police's own Strategic Development Plan 2025-2029 lists among its priorities a transition from a paper-based to a digital records management system, and among its weaknesses that internal records management interventions have not worked and a digital system is necessary; the monitoring framework sets the baseline at 2024.

The plan treats the e-Case Management System as still to be established: against a 2024 baseline its 2025 milestone is a survey on the status of case management, with implementation of the survey's recommendations from 2026 to 2028 and an effective system as the 2029 target.

The Sierra Leone Police Strategic Development Plan 2025-2029 names an e-Case Management System for case tracking and processing as key intervention 4.3 under Strategic Goal 4, with yearly milestones from 2025 to a 2029 target; the plan prints no date, and the 2025-01-29 used is read from its file name.

The plan makes the e-Case Management System the force's own undertaking, with Crime Services as the responsible directorate in the monitoring framework; the plan prints no date, and the 2025-01-29 used is read from its file name.

The plan gives no budget for the e-Case Management System; for the paired digital records management system its 2025 milestone is project initiation documents and the identification of a partner for sponsorship, and it says government allocation, limited and late, remains the force's main funding.

systems.tiers: planned: survey of case management in 2025, implementation 2026 to 2028, target 2029; no station named
the force as a whole, baseline 2024

systems.system: digital records management system (personnel and criminal records)
systems.owner: Sierra Leone Police (HRM, Operations and Crime)
systems.tiers: planned: intervention 4.2 migrates personnel records from paper to digital; the monitoring framework adds criminal records, with a sponsor to be identified in 2025 and implementation 2026 to 2028

a centralised database at CID Headquarters and regional offices, set up under the 2020-2024 plan to share criminal data on organised crime, money laundering and human trafficking among law enforcement agencies; the plan does not say stations enter cases in it
specific locations in the Western Area and Police Headquarters, monitored round the clock
planned: donor engagement 2025, pilot in part of Freetown 2026, all Freetown 2027, provincial regional headquarters 2028

systems.system: integrated command and control centre with GPS tracking of patrol vehicles and toll-free distress lines
systems.tiers: GPS fitted to all operational vehicles in the Western Area under the 2020-2024 plan; the centre is planned for 2025 to 2029

systems.owner: Sierra Leone Police with the Sierra Leone Road Safety Authority
systems.tiers: planned: consultations 2025, pilot in the Western Area 2026, nationwide 2027 to 2028
planned: 200 body cameras a year from 2025, and 5 drones in 2025 rising to a target of 15

systems.system: smart police stations with mobile apps and data dashboards for online reporting, crime reporting and real-time information sharing
systems.tiers: planned: apps and dashboards built 2025, Western Area 2026, provincial regional headquarters 2027, provincial divisions 2028

systems.system: bar-coded police badges replacing biometric ID cards

systems.tiers: the force's communication system, overhauled under the 2020-2024 plan; HF and VHF sets for personnel and stations planned from 2025

systems.system: internet connectivity for police stations and departments
systems.tiers: poor in most police facilities as of the plan; planned for the 6 regional headquarters and training facilities in 2025, Western Area divisions in 2026, provincial divisional headquarters in 2027 and 2028

systems.system: solar power for police stations and other facilities
systems.tiers: planned: 8 divisional headquarters and 7 police stations a year from 2025 to 2028; electricity inadequate in police facilities, especially rural ones, which rely on thermal generators
listed as insufficient among the critical challenges of 2020-2024

note: The plan does not name the occurrence book or the docket, and says nothing of how any one station records; it gives no count of stations, only that 38 divisions are implied by its patrol arithmetic. Its tables of reported crime for 2020 to 2024 name no system.
